definitions.intro: For the purposes of these Terms, the following definitions apply:

eligibility.ageRequirements: To create an Account on Podacium, you must be at least 16 years old. Users aged 16 to 18 may access the Platform only with parental or legal guardian consent, in accordance with applicable Algerian law.
eligibility.parentalConsentItem1: A parent or legal guardian must provide consent by submitting verified identification
eligibility.parentalConsentItem2: Podacium retains proof of parental consent securely for audit and compliance purposes
eligibility.parentalConsentItem3: Parents or guardians may revoke consent at any time by contacting us
eligibility.accountRegistration: To access full Platform features, you must create an Account by providing your full legal name, valid email address, date of birth, and a password meeting our security requirements.
eligibility.accountSecurity: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your Account credentials and all activities that occur under your Account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use or security breach.
eligibility.accountTypes: Podacium supports Individual Learner Accounts, Freelancer Accounts, Business Accounts, and Institutional Accounts, each with specific features and requirements.

services.educationalServices: Podacium provides online learning services including pre-recorded video courses, interactive exercises, learning paths, completion certificates, PDF materials, and AI-powered tutoring when available.
services.certificatesAndCredentials: Certificates issued by Podacium represent successful completion of course requirements but are not formal academic degrees or accredited qualifications. They are informal credentials for continuing education.
services.aiServices: Podacium may utilize artificial intelligence technologies to enhance learning experiences. AI features include conversational tutors, personalized recommendations, automated assessments, and content generation tools. Important disclaimers apply to AI-generated content.
services.biFeatures: Podacium offers Business Intelligence analytics tools for individual users (learning progress dashboards, performance analytics) and business/institutional users (employee learning analytics, team performance dashboards, custom reporting).

responsibilities.licenseToUse: Subject to compliance with these Terms, Podacium grants you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to access and use the Platform for personal or internal business purposes.
responsibilities.permittedUses: You may access courses you have enrolled in, participate in Platform forums, create User-Generated Content in accordance with these Terms, use BI Features for legitimate analytics purposes, and download materials explicitly designated as downloadable.
responsibilities.prohibitedUses: You must not use the Platform for any illegal purpose, engage in academic dishonesty, share Account credentials, reverse engineer the Platform, use automated systems to collect data, circumvent payment systems, upload malicious code, harass other users, impersonate others, or misuse AI Services.

intellectualProperty.ourIP: All Platform Content, including source code, software, algorithms, course materials, AI models, Platform design, trademarks, logos, and Business Intelligence tools, is owned by Podacium SARL or licensed to us by third parties. All rights are reserved.
intellectualProperty.userContentOwnership: You retain ownership of all User-Generated Content you create, including course assignments, forum posts, reviews, and freelance work deliverables.
intellectualProperty.licenseToPodacium: By submitting User-Generated Content to the Platform, you grant Podacium a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable, and transferable license to display, reproduce, and distribute your content on the Platform.

payments.pricing: Course prices, subscription fees, and Freelancing Marketplace commissions are displayed on the Platform in Algerian Dinars (DZD) or other applicable currencies. Prices may change at any time.
payments.paymentMethods: Podacium accepts payments through licensed third-party payment gateways, including Algerian bank cards (CIB, EDAHABIA), SATIM payment system, and other licensed or international payment processors.
payments.taxes: Prices displayed are inclusive of applicable Algerian taxes (VAT/TVA) unless otherwise stated. International users may be subject to additional taxes in their jurisdiction.
payments.refundPolicy: Detailed refund terms are provided in our separate Refund Policy. Key points include a 7-day full refund for course purchases if no content has been accessed, pro-rata refunds for partial completion, and specific non-refundable circumstances.

dataProtection.privacyCommitment: Podacium is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with Algerian Law 18-07 on the Protection of Personal Data. Full details of our data practices are provided in our Privacy Policy.
dataProtection.userRights: You have the right to access your personal data, correct inaccurate data, delete your data (subject to legal retention requirements), object to certain data processing activities, withdraw consent for non-essential data processing, and lodge complaints with Algeria's National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data (ANPDP).
dataProtection.dataRetention: Personal data is deleted 6 months after Account deletion. Financial records are retained 10 years in anonymized form. Course completion certificates are retained indefinitely for verification purposes.

thirdParty.integrations: Podacium integrates with third-party services including payment processors, artificial intelligence service providers, analytics tools, cloud hosting providers, and communication services. These services have their own terms and privacy policies.
thirdParty.liability: Podacium uses reasonable efforts to select reliable third-party providers. However, we are not responsible for third-party service failures, outages, or errors. We maintain backup systems where technically feasible.

disclaimers.educationalDisclaimer: Podacium does not guarantee that completing courses will result in specific learning outcomes, employment, academic credit, or professional licensure. Educational success depends on individual effort and external factors beyond our control.
disclaimers.aiDisclaimer: AI Services may produce incorrect, incomplete, or misleading information. AI recommendations are general suggestions only and do not constitute professional advice. Consult qualified professionals for important decisions.
disclaimers.limitationOfLiability: To the maximum extent permitted under Algerian law, Podacium is not liable for indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages. Where Podacium is found liable, our total liability is capped at the lesser of fees paid in the preceding 12 months or 50,000 Algerian Dinars.

forceMajeure.intro: Podacium is not liable for delays or failures to perform obligations due to events beyond our reasonable control, including natural disasters, pandemics, war, government actions, internet infrastructure failures, cyberattacks, third-party service provider failures, labor strikes, or power outages.

termination.byUser: You may delete your Account at any time using the self-service deletion option in Account settings or by contacting support. Effect of deletion includes immediate access revocation, personal data deletion within 6 months, and retention of financial records for 10 years.
termination.byPodacium: We may suspend or terminate your Account immediately without notice for serious Terms violations (fraud, illegal activity, harassment, repeated infringement, academic dishonesty, or threatening Platform security).

disputeResolution.governingLaw: These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Algeria, including Law 18-07 on Protection of Personal Data, Law 18-05 on Electronic Commerce, Law 09-03 on Consumer Protection, and the Algerian Civil and Commercial Codes.
disputeResolution.jurisdiction: Any disputes arising from or relating to these Terms or your use of the Platform shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Oran, Algeria.
disputeResolution.adr: Before initiating court proceedings, parties agree to attempt resolution through good-faith negotiation (30 days) and mediation through a mutually agreed mediator in Algeria. ADR does not prevent either party from seeking urgent injunctive relief.

generalProvisions.entireAgreement: These Terms, together with the Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, and Refund Policy, constitute the entire agreement between you and Podacium regarding Platform use, superseding all prior agreements and understandings.
generalProvisions.language: These Terms are drafted in English. An official Arabic version will be published as the authoritative legal version. Upon publication, the Arabic version shall become the legally binding version. In case of any conflict between translations, the official Arabic version shall prevail.

introduction.ourCommitment: Podacium SARL ('Podacium', 'we', 'us', or 'our') is committed to protecting the privacy and personal data of all users of our educational platform ('Platform'). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, share, and protect your personal information in accordance with Algerian Law No. 18-07 of 10 June 2018 on the Protection of Personal Data ('Law 18-07').
introduction.scope: This Privacy Policy applies to all users of the Podacium Platform, including: Individual learners and students, Freelancers (when Freelancing Marketplace launches), Business and institutional users, Guest visitors, Minors (with parental consent).
introduction.regulatoryCompliance: Podacium is committed to compliance with: Algerian Law 18-07 on Protection of Personal Data, National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data (ANPDP) regulations, International best practices for data protection. We have filed (or will file prior to commercial launch) all required data processing declarations with ANPDP and will obtain necessary authorizations for cross-border data transfers.
introduction.relationshipToPolicies: This Privacy Policy should be read together with: Terms of Service (which incorporates consent provisions in Section 7.8), Cookie Policy (detailing our use of cookies and tracking technologies), Refund Policy.

legalBasis.intro: Under Law 18-07, we process your personal data based on the following legal grounds:

main.title: By accepting our Terms of Service, you provide explicit, informed, and freely given consent to:
items: Collection and processing of your personal data as described in this Policy
Use of cookies and tracking technologies as described in our Cookie Policy
Communications from Podacium regarding your Account and services
Processing for the purposes specified in Section 4 of this Policy

consent.withdrawal: You may withdraw consent at any time by:
consent.withdrawal1: Adjusting privacy settings in your Account dashboard

items: ID document for minors' parental consent

dataCollection.authenticationData: Username, Password (encrypted), Account creation date, Last login date and time, Two-factor authentication credentials (if enabled), Social login tokens (if you use Google/Facebook login).
dataCollection.usageLearningData: Educational Activity: Courses enrolled, viewed, and completed; Video watch time and progress; Quiz and assignment submissions; Learning path progress; Certificate issuance records. Platform Interaction: Pages visited and navigation patterns; Time spent on platform; Features used; Search queries; Content downloads.
dataCollection.technicalDeviceData: IP address, Browser type and version, Operating system, Device type (desktop, mobile, tablet), Screen resolution, Referring website/source, Geographic location (country/city level, derived from IP), Language preferences, Time zone.
dataCollection.communicationData: Email correspondence with support team, In-platform messages, Support ticket content, Survey responses, Feedback submissions.
dataCollection.biData: For Individual Users: Engagement metrics, Learning analytics, Performance trends. For Business/Institutional Users: Employee learning progress, Team performance dashboards, Training ROI metrics, Aggregated workforce analytics. Note: Enterprise BI clients may upload confidential business data. Such data is subject to additional security measures and Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs).
dataCollection.aiInteractionData: When AI Services launch: Questions asked to AI tutors, AI-generated responses, Feedback on AI accuracy, AI learning path recommendations accepted/rejected. Important: AI interaction data will only be used for AI training with explicit consent and in anonymized, aggregated form.

gateway.title: Processed by third-party payment gateways (not stored by Podacium):

dataCollection.userGeneratedContent: Course assignments and projects, Forum posts and comments, Reviews and ratings, Uploaded files (within platform limits), Profile pictures (optional), Freelance work deliverables (when Marketplace launches).

dataNotCollected.title: Podacium does not collect:
items: National ID card numbers (except for parental consent verification)
Criminal history (unless required for specific institutional programs)

dataUsage.optOut: You can opt out of marketing communications at any time via:
dataUsage.aiTraining: Important: Only anonymized, aggregated data will be used for AI training, and only with explicit user consent.

dataRetention.activeAccounts: Data is retained as long as your Account remains active and for the purposes for which it was collected.

deletedAccounts.intro: Upon Account deletion: Personal Identification Data: Deleted within 6 months of Account deletion request. Financial and Transaction Records: Retained for 10 years in anonymized form. Course Completion Certificates: Retained indefinitely for verification purposes. User-Generated Content: Public forum posts: Anonymized (author name removed) but content retained; Private assignments: Deleted with Account.

dataRetention.backupData: Backups containing your data are deleted within 90 days of Account deletion. Backup retention necessary for disaster recovery and system integrity.

dataSharing.noSale: Podacium does not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.

serviceProviders.title: We share data with trusted third-party service providers who process data on our behalf:
serviceProviders.note: All third-party processors sign Data Processing Agreements and comply with Algerian Law 18-07.

dataSharing.aggregateData: We may share anonymized, aggregated data that cannot be used to identify individuals with: Educational researchers, Industry partners, Government agencies, The public (via reports and publications). Example: '70% of users complete courses within 3 months' or 'Algerian learners prefer video content over text.'

crossBorder.dataLocalization: Primary data storage: All personal data is stored on servers physically located in Algeria.
crossBorder.internationalTransfers: Under Law 18-07, cross-border transfers of personal data require prior authorization from the National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data (ANPDP). Circumstances requiring international transfer: Backup storage on EU servers (for disaster recovery), AI service providers located outside Algeria, International analytics tools, Payment processors serving international users.

localHosting.title: Local Data Hosting
items: All personal data of Algerian users is hosted on servers physically located within Algeria
We partner with OCCtenium (occidentium.dz), an Algerian cloud infrastructure provider, for primary data storage
Secondary infrastructure utilizes Algerie Telecom's data center facilities
This ensures compliance with Law 18-07's data localization requirements and ANPDP regulations
localHosting.note: Cross-border data transfers only occur with prior ANPDP authorization and appropriate safeguards as described above.

securityMeasures.intro: Podacium implements industry-standard technical and organizational measures to protect personal data:

dataSecurity.breachResponse: In the event of a personal data breach: Detection and Assessment (within 24 hours), Notification to ANPDP (within 48-72 hours), Notification to Affected Users (within 72 hours), Remediation, Post-Incident Review.

userResponsibilities.title: While we implement strong security measures, you also have responsibilities:
items: Keep your password confidential and strong
Log out after using shared devices
Keep your contact information up to date
userResponsibilities.note: We are not liable for unauthorized access resulting from your failure to protect Account credentials.

userRights.intro: You have the following rights under Algerian Law 18-07:
items: Right of access — know what data we hold about you
Right to rectification — correct inaccurate data
Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten')
Right to object — object to certain processing
Right to data portability — receive your data in a portable format
Right to withdraw consent at any time
Right to lodge a complaint with ANPDP
userRights.responseTimes: We commit to responding to all rights requests: Acknowledgment: Within 48 hours, Complete response: Within 15 days, Complex requests: Up to 30 days (with notification of delay). Exercising your rights is free of charge.

minorsProtection.ageRequirements: Minimum age to create Account: 16 years. Users under 19 years are considered Minors under Algerian law and require parental consent.

parentalConsent.intro: For users aged 16-18: Verifiable parental or legal guardian consent required. Parent must provide: Scanned ID document, OR Phone number verification via OTP.
parentalConsent.process1: Minor provides parent/guardian contact information during registration
parentalConsent.process3: Account activated only after consent verified

policyChanges.notificationChanges: Material changes will be communicated via: Email notification to registered users (at least 15 days before effective date), Prominent notice on Platform homepage, In-app notification upon next login.
policyChanges.consentChanges: Continued use of Platform after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of updated Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with changes: Discontinue Platform use, Delete your Account before effective date, Exercise data subject rights (access, deletion, etc.).

currentStatus.intro: EU and US users are currently geo-blocked pending full compliance implementation.
items: Comply with GDPR's stricter data protection requirements
Offer all GDPR data subject rights
Implement GDPR-compliant data breach notification (72 hours)
currentStatus.note: We are actively preparing for expansion into European, North American, and MENA markets with region-specific privacy compliance frameworks.

internationalUsers.euStatus: Podacium is committed to GDPR compliance for users in the European Economic Area. We are actively implementing the necessary safeguards including appointment of an EU representative, Standard Contractual Clauses for data transfers, and a Data Processing Agreement. Full GDPR compliance documentation will be available before expanding into EU markets.
internationalUsers.ccpaStatus: Podacium is committed to CCPA compliance for users in California, USA. Full CCPA compliance will be finalized before expanding into the US market.
internationalUsers.ksaPDPL: Podacium is committed to compliance with Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and the UAE's Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 for users in these jurisdictions. We are actively monitoring regulatory developments and will implement region-specific privacy frameworks before expanding into these markets.
internationalUsers.expansionContact: For questions about our international data protection compliance, please contact our Data Protection Officer.

biEnterprise.additionalProtections: Enterprise clients using BI features benefit from: Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), Data Isolation (complete separation from other users' data), Custom Security (additional encryption and access controls), Dedicated Support (priority data protection assistance).
biEnterprise.clientResponsibilities: Enterprise clients are responsible for: Obtaining necessary consents from employees, Ensuring lawful basis for providing employee data, Compliance with employment and labor laws, Data minimization (only upload necessary data).

responseTimes.dataRequests: Data subject rights requests: 15 days (up to 30 days for complex requests)

contact.anpdpContact: National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data: 01, Rue Ahmed Ouaked, Dely Ibrahim, Algiers, Algeria. Website: https://www.anpdp.dz, Email: contact@anpdp.dz.

introduction.policyExplanation: This Cookie Policy explains how Podacium SARL ('Podacium,' 'we,' 'us,' or 'our') uses cookies and similar tracking technologies on our website and platform (collectively, the 'Platform'). This policy should be read in conjunction with our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
introduction.complianceCommitment: We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency about our data practices in full compliance with Algerian Law No. 18-07 of June 10, 2018, on the Protection of Individuals in the Processing of Personal Data.

whatAreCookies.definition: Cookies are small text files placed on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile) when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work efficiently, remember your preferences, and provide information to the website owners.
whatAreCookies.trackingTechnologies: We also use similar tracking technologies such as web beacons, pixels, and local storage (collectively referred to as 'cookies' in this policy).

howWeUseCookies.intro: We use cookies for the following purposes, based on the legal grounds outlined in Algerian Law 18-07:

yourConsentControl.priorConsent: In accordance with Article 4 of Law 18-07, we require your freely given, specific, informed, and unambiguous consent before placing any non-essential cookies on your device.

consentFlow.step2: User Chooses: [Accept All] OR [Reject Non-Essential] OR [Customize Preferences]
consentFlow.step3: Choice Saved (`cookie_consent` cookie set for 1 year)
consentFlow.step4: Respective Cookies Placed → User can change choice anytime
consentFlow.point1: On first visit: Clear cookie consent banner with granular options
consentFlow.point2: Granular Control: Give or refuse consent independently for each category
consentFlow.point3: No Implied Consent: Browsing without interaction ≠ valid consent
consentFlow.point4: Consent Storage: Preference stored in `cookie_consent` for 1 year

yourConsentControl.withdrawConsent: You have the right to withdraw or modify your cookie consent at any time, with future effect. Withdrawal will not affect strictly necessary cookies required for Platform operation.

manageOptions.option1: Access 'Cookie Preferences' in your Account dashboard
manageOptions.option2: Click the cookie icon/link in website footer
manageOptions.option4: Clear browser cookies (will reset preferences and require re-login)

yourConsentControl.rejectionWarning: If you reject cookies or withdraw consent, non-essential cookies will be deleted promptly and will cease to be set on future visits.
yourConsentControl.browserSettings: You can also control cookies through your web browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies, or set preferences for certain websites.

browserGuides.chrome: Manage cookies in Chrome browser settings
browserGuides.safari: Control cookies and website data in Safari
browserGuides.edge: Delete and manage cookies in Microsoft Edge

yourConsentControl.blockingWarning: Blocking all cookies, especially Strictly Necessary ones, will severely impact your ability to use the Podacium Platform.

typesOfCookies.firstPartyCookies: These are set directly by Podacium on our primary domain (podacium.com) as well as our secondary domains (podacium.dz, podacium.com.dz), all pointing to the same server.
typesOfCookies.thirdPartyCookies: These are set by domains other than Podacium, by our trusted service providers. Their use is strictly governed by Data Processing Agreements to ensure compliance with Algerian law.

detailedCookieList.strictlyNecessaryNote: Strictly necessary cookies are essential for the Platform to function and are placed without prior consent as required by Algerian Law 18-07 Article 5.
detailedCookieList.analyticsNote: Analytics cookies are only placed with your explicit consent via the cookie banner.
detailedCookieList.functionalityMarketingNote: We currently do not use functionality or marketing cookies. Any future implementation will be listed here and will require your explicit opt-in.
detailedCookieList.updateNote: This table will be updated immediately following a complete cookie audit and may include additional cookies as necessary.

dataRetention.intro: Cookie data is retained only for the duration specified in the cookie table above ('Session' cookies are deleted when you close your browser).
dataRetention.privacyPolicyReference: Personal data collected via cookies is processed according to the retention periods outlined in our Privacy Policy.

dataTransfers.intro: The use of certain third-party cookies may involve the transfer of personal data to servers located outside of Algeria. As per Articles 31-33 of Law 18-07, any such cross-border data transfer requires prior authorization from the Algerian National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data (ANPDP).

ourCommitments.commitment1: Not activating any service involving international data transfer via cookies without first obtaining required ANPDP authorization
ourCommitments.commitment2: Informing you in this policy and via cookie banner of any international transfers

introduction.policyExplanation: This Refund Policy governs all refund requests for products and services purchased through the Podacium platform, operated by Podacium SARL, an Algerian limited liability company registered in Algeria.
introduction.languageNotice: The official legal version of this document is in Arabic. Translations are provided for convenience only. In case of any discrepancy, the Arabic version shall prevail.
introduction.multiPillarEcosystem: Podacium operates a multi-pillar digital ecosystem comprising Education Platform (online courses, learning paths), Subscription Services (Student tiers, Business Intelligence access), Freelancing Marketplace (project-based services with feature-based pricing), and Digital Wallet System (PodaPoints payment processing and feature purchases).
introduction.relationshipToTerms: This Refund Policy is incorporated into and forms part of the Podacium Terms of Service. In case of conflict between this Policy and the Terms, this Policy shall prevail for refund-specific matters.

generalPrinciples.digitalContentBarrier: Once digital content is accessed (video viewed, document downloaded, quiz attempted, lesson completed), it is considered delivered and consumed. Refunds are not available for accessed content unless the content is materially defective or not as described.
generalPrinciples.servicePerformance: Platform services (infrastructure access, payment processing, user matching, dispute resolution) are distinct from content or products purchased. Service fees for activated feature purchases are non-refundable once rendered, regardless of user satisfaction with outcomes.
generalPrinciples.consumerProtection: Nothing in this Refund Policy excludes or limits your mandatory rights under Algerian Law 09-03 on Consumer Protection (as amended by Law 18-09), including your rights to accurate product information, safe and quality services, redress for defective services, and filing complaints with consumer protection authorities.
generalPrinciples.withdrawalRight: Under Algerian consumer law (Law 09-03), consumers have a 14-day withdrawal right for distance contracts. However, pursuant to the exception for digital content (Article 4 of Executive Decree 14-134), you expressly consent to immediate access and lose your withdrawal right once the digital content is fully performed (course accessed, video streamed, or certificate issued). Our 7-day refund window exceeds the legal minimum guarantee period for digital content quality, and the 14-day right does not apply when you have expressly requested performance before the withdrawal period expired.

educationRefunds.individualCourse7Day: You may request a full refund for an individual course purchase within 7 days of purchase if: You have not accessed any course content (0% progress), No certificate has been issued, The request is submitted through official channels.
educationRefunds.individualCourseConditional: If you have accessed 1-30% of course content within the 7-day window, a refund may be granted at Podacium's discretion if you can demonstrate that the course content is materially different from the published description or specific advertised features are missing.
educationRefunds.individualCourseNoRefund: No refunds are available if: You have consumed more than 30% of course content, More than 7 days have passed since purchase, You have downloaded course materials or completed assessments, A certificate has been issued.
educationRefunds.courseBundles: Course bundles and learning paths are sold as integrated products at a discounted price. Partial refunds for individual courses within a bundle are not available. Full bundle refunds follow the 7-day, 0% access rule for ALL courses in the bundle.
educationRefunds.liveCoursesBeforeStart: For live courses: Full refund available up to 48 hours before the scheduled start time. No refund within 48 hours of start time due to instructor scheduling and capacity commitments.
educationRefunds.liveCoursesAfterStart: No refunds available once the first scheduled session has started, as the service has been rendered. Exception: If Podacium or the instructor cancels the course entirely or reschedules with less than 48 hours' notice, full refunds are automatically available.
educationRefunds.certificatesIssued: Once a certificate is issued: The course is considered fully delivered, No refunds are available, Certificate revocation does not entitle you to a refund.

subscriptionRefunds.first72Hours: Within the first 72 hours of a new subscription or tier upgrade, you may request a full refund if: You have not accessed any premium features or content, This is your first subscription to this tier.
subscriptionRefunds.thirtyDayCommitment: The first 30 days of each billing cycle are non-refundable (except during the 72-hour cooling-off period). This ensures platform sustainability and prevents systematic subscription cycling.
subscriptionRefunds.proRataRefunds: After the first 30 days of a billing cycle, pro-rata refunds for unused subscription periods may be granted at Podacium's discretion, subject to Algerian consumer protection law requirements.
subscriptionRefunds.automaticRenewal: Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled before the renewal date. Podacium sends renewal notices at least 7 days in advance via email and in-app notification.
subscriptionRefunds.failedNoticeProtection: If Podacium fails to send the required 7-day advance notice, you are entitled to a full refund of that renewal cycle upon request within 14 days of the renewal charge.
subscriptionRefunds.pauseFeature: You may pause your subscription for up to 3 months (90 days) through your Account settings. Pausing is not a refund – your payment obligation is suspended during the pause period. No refunds are issued for paused subscriptions.

freelancingRefunds.statusNotice: The Freelancing Marketplace uses a feature-based pricing model. There are no commissions on projects.
freelancingRefunds.featurePurchaseRefund: Feature purchases (project posts, featured listings, boosts, skill passport) are non-refundable once activated. If a feature has not been activated (e.g., project post not yet published), a refund may be requested within 48 hours of purchase.
freelancingRefunds.unusedPoints: Unused PodaPoints remain in your wallet and never expire as long as you have wallet activity within 365 days. You may use them for any future feature purchase.
freelancingRefunds.disputeResolution: For project-related disputes between clients and freelancers, Podacium offers voluntary mediation. Feature purchases related to a disputed project are not eligible for refund.
freelancingRefunds.noCommission: No platform commissions are charged on any project payments. The platform is funded through feature purchases and subscription plans.

technicalIssues.downtimeLess24Hours: Platform downtime <24 hours cumulative per month: No refunds issued, Subscription access periods automatically extended to compensate for downtime.
technicalIssues.downtimeMore24Hours: Platform downtime >24 hours cumulative per month: Subscription users receive pro-rata credit, Non-subscription users receive access period extension equal to downtime duration.
technicalIssues.catastrophicDowntime: Catastrophic downtime (>7 consecutive days): Automatic pro-rata refunds issued, Users notified via email, Subscriptions automatically paused until service restoration.
technicalIssues.technicalDefects: If purchased content contains technical defects (broken videos, inaccessible files, non-functional quizzes): Report within 30 days with evidence, Podacium investigates within 7 days, Choose full refund, replacement course, or 120% Platform credit.
technicalIssues.contentUnavailability: If content is permanently removed from the Platform: Individual courses receive pro-rata refund based on time remaining, Subscriptions receive pro-rata credit, Bundles receive proportional refund based on removed content's standalone value.

forceMajeure.interruptionsLess14Days: Force majeure interruptions less than 14 consecutive days: No refunds issued, Access periods and subscription billing automatically suspended during event, Time lost is added to your access period.
forceMajeure.interruptionsMore14Days: Force majeure interruptions exceeding 14 consecutive days: Podacium offers access period extension (2× downtime), Platform wallet credit (pro-rata), or cash refund (pro-rata) at Podacium's discretion.
forceMajeure.notification: Podacium will notify users of force majeure events via email, Platform homepage notice, and social media announcements with details of the event and expected duration.

paymentProcessing.refundMethod: Refunds are processed using the original payment method unless: Original payment method is no longer valid, User explicitly requests Platform wallet credit, Payment processor does not support refunds.
paymentProcessing.processingTime: Standard timeline: 5-10 business days from approval to funds availability. Wallet refunds: Immediate (credited within 24 hours).
paymentProcessing.currency: Algerian users: All transactions and refunds in Algerian Dinars (DZD). International users: Refunds in original transaction currency at original exchange rate. Platform credits issued in DZD for all users.
paymentProcessing.taxHandling: All prices include applicable Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA) at current Algerian rate. Refunds include TVA paid on refunded amount. Podacium issues credit note (note de crédit) for all refunds for tax compliance.

platformCredits.creditBonus: For eligible refund requests, Podacium may offer Platform credits as alternative to cash refunds with bonus incentives: 110% credit bonus for refunds required by law or policy, 120% credit bonus for discretionary refunds.
platformCredits.creditTerms: Platform credits: Valid for 12 months from issuance, Can be used for course purchases, subscriptions, freelancing services, May be gifted to other users, Cannot be converted back to cash, Expire after 12 months.
platformCredits.userChoice: Credits are always optional. You may decline and receive standard cash refund (no bonus).

fraudPrevention.abuseIndicators: Podacium reserves the right to deny refunds and suspend Accounts for systematic abuse including: More than 2 refund requests within 6 months, Refund requests on more than 30% of total purchases, High content consumption before refund request.
fraudPrevention.largeRefundVerification: Refunds exceeding 10,000 DZD require identity verification to comply with Algerian anti-money laundering regulations, fraud prevention protocols, and tax compliance requirements.
fraudPrevention.chargebackPolicy: Legitimate chargebacks (unauthorized transaction, billing error, service not received): Podacium honors the chargeback. Fraudulent chargebacks (service delivered and consumed): Podacium may contest, suspend Account, ban payment methods, pursue legal action.
fraudPrevention.chargebackFees: Filing a chargeback waives your right to standard refund processing. Contact support before involving your bank. Most issues can be resolved faster through direct communication.

specialCases.giftPurchases: For courses or subscriptions purchased as gifts: Only original purchaser may request refund, Subject to standard refund conditions, Gift recipient has no refund rights.
specialCases.duplicatePurchases: Accidental duplicate purchases: Contact within 48 hours of duplicate charge, Provide transaction IDs, Full refund issued for duplicate charge within 3-5 business days.
specialCases.accountDeletion: Account deletion requests: Pro-rata refunds available only for unused subscription periods after 30-day minimum, No refunds for individual course purchases, Wallet balance can be refunded to bank account.
specialCases.deceasedUsers: Deceased user accounts: Authorized family members may request refunds for active subscriptions and unused wallet balances, Required documentation: death certificate, legal authorization, proof of relationship.
specialCases.promotionalPurchases: Purchases at promotional prices: Refunds calculated based on actual amount paid (discounted price), not original full price, Discount codes not refunded separately.
specialCases.bundleUpgrades: Subscription tier upgrades: No pro-rata refund for unused portion of lower tier, Upgrade cost calculated as difference between tiers pro-rated for remaining cycle.

procedures.requiredInformation: All refund requests must include: Transaction ID or order number, Account email address, Date of purchase, Product/service name, Detailed reason for refund, Supporting evidence (if applicable).
procedures.processingTimeline: Acknowledgment: 24-48 hours, Review and decision: 3-5 business days, Complex investigations: 7-14 business days, Refund processing: 5-10 business days to payment method.
procedures.statusTracking: Track refund status via: Email notifications, Account Dashboard Refund History section, Support ticket system updates.

disputeResolution.internalAppeals: If refund request denied: Submit appeal within 14 days via email, Include reference number and detailed explanation, Senior reviewer assesses appeal, Final decision within 7 business days.
disputeResolution.externalResolution: If not satisfied with internal appeal: File complaint with Algerian Direction Générale du Commerce (DGC), Contact National Authority for Protection of Personal Data (ANPDP) for data-related disputes, Pursue legal action in Algerian courts.
disputeResolution.voluntaryMediation: Before legal action, both parties may agree to voluntary mediation: Select mutually agreed mediator, Costs split equally, Typically concluded within 30-45 days, Non-binding unless both parties agree.

policyUpdates.rightToModify: Podacium reserves the right to modify this Refund Policy to reflect changes in Algerian law, platform features, operational improvements, fraud prevention measures, or user feedback.
policyUpdates.noticeOfChanges: Material changes (reducing user rights): Email notification 30 days before effective date, In-app notification, Platform homepage notice. Non-material changes: Updated date only.
policyUpdates.acceptanceOfChanges: Continued use of Platform after effective date constitutes acceptance of updated Refund Policy. If you disagree: Discontinue use before effective date, Request refunds for active subscriptions, Exercise data subject rights.
policyUpdates.grandfatheringProvision: Purchases made before policy change are governed by policy in effect at time of purchase, unless change is legally required, provides greater protections, or both parties agree to new terms.
